title: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play

paper.title: Mastering Chess and Shogi by Self-Play with a General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
paper.authors: David Silver, Thomas Hubert, Julian Schrittwieser, et al.
paper.summary: Combines a neural network with Monte Carlo tree search, trained purely by self-play, and learns chess, shogi and Go from the rules alone.
